framework.name: Strategic Priority 1: People - Human Development and Equal Participation

children.name: Outcome 1.1: By 2025, effective, inclusive and accountable institutions ensure equal access for all people living in Kazakhstan, especially most vulnerable, to quality and gender sensitive social services according to the principle of leaving no one behind
children.description:
In support of Strategic Priority 1: People - Human Development and Equal Participation.
Participating UN Agencies: UNICEF, UNFPA, UNDP, UNAIDS, UNODC, IOM, WHO, UN Women.

children.name: Output 1.1.1: Improved capacity of authorities at national and sub-national level to provide effective social protection programmes and social services, including COVID-19 related services, with the focus on the most vulnerable groups.
children.description:
In support of Outcome 1.1
UNICEF, UNDP, UN Women, UNFPA, IOM

children.name: Output 1.1.2: Increased capacity of policy makers and health service providers to improve access to selected quality health services and goods, including those related to COVID-19, HIV, reproductive and mental health related services, for everyone especially the most vulnerable groups of population.
children.description:
In support of Outcome 1.1

Participating agencies: UNFPA, UNICEF, WHO, UNDP, UNAIDS, UNHCR

children.name: Outcome 1.2. By 2025 all people in Kazakhstan especially the most vulnerable are empowered with knowledge and skills to equally contribute to sustainable development of the country.
children.description:
In support of Strategic Priority 1: People - Human Development and Equal Participation.
Participating UN Agencies: UNESCO, UNICEF, UNFPA, UNAIDS, UNODC, IOM, WHO, UN Women.

children.name: Output 1.2.1: Increased capacities of education stakeholders to respond to evolving learning environment including through strengthening inclusive  blended and digital learning.
children.description:
In support of Outcome 1.2.
Participating agencies: UNESCO, UNICEF, UNODC, UNHCR, UNFPA, ITU, UN Women

children.name: Output 1.2.2: Improved knowledge and life skills of People of Kazakhstan, especially vulnerable groups for sustainable development, well-being and resilience.
children.description:
In support of Outcome 1.2.
Participating agencies: UNFPA, UNWOMEN, UNICEF, UNESCO, ITU

framework.name: Strategic Priority 2: Peace - Effective Institutions, Human Rights and Gender Equality

children.name: Outcome 2.1: By 2025, all people in Kazakhstan are protected and enjoy full realization of human rights and gender equality and a life free from discrimination, violence and threats, and equally participate in decision making
children.description:
In support of Strategic Priority 2: Peace - Effective Institutions, Human Rights and Gender Equality.
Participating UN Agencies: OHCHR, UN Women, UNODC, UNAIDS, IOM, UNHCR, UNFPA, WHO, UNESCO, UNDP, UNICEF

children.name: Output 2.1.1: Legislative framework has increased compliance with international standards for realization of human rights, gender equality and a life free from discrimination, violence and threats
children.description:
In support of Outcome 2.1
Participating agencies: IOM, OHCHR, UNODC, UNESCO, UNICEF, UN Women

children.name: Output 2.1.2:Increased capacities of state institutions and other relevant organizations to expand access to justice and combat discrimination with a focus on women and marginalized groups
children.description:
In support of outcome 2.1.
Participating agencies: UNAIDS, OHCHR, UN Women, IOM, UNODC, UNDP, UNESCO, UNHCR, UNICEF

children.name: Output 2.1.3:  Increased participation of women and representatives of marginalized and vulnerable groups in decision-making in the public, quasi-public and private sector

children.name: Outcome 2.2: By 2025, state institutions at all levels effectively design and implement gender-sensitive, human rights and evidence-based public policies and provide quality services in an inclusive, transparent and accountable manner.

In support of Strategic Priority 2: Peace - Effective Institutions, Human Rights and Gender Equality.

In support of Outcome 2.2.

children.name: Output 2.2.2: Strengthened capacities of government authorities and CSOs for effective, efficient, timely and inclusive provision of specialized social services with a focus on the most vulnerable groups, including the context of the Covid-19 pandemic

In support of Outcome 2.2.

children.name: Output 2.2.3: Strengthened national systems of data collection and analysis for the formulation of evidence-based national human-rights and gender equality policies and development programmes aligned with international standards and SDGs
